items.title: Saquon Barkley: Questionable for Week 7
items.text:
Barkley (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Cowboys.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dallas Goedert: Good to go against Dallas
items.text:
Goedert (knee) was a full participant in Saturday's practice and does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Cowboys.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Ruled out for Monday Night Football
items.text:
Smith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Cowboys.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tank Dell: Activated from injured reserve
items.text:
Dell (knee) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Jacobs had his roster exemption removed by the Packers and is expected to play Sunday at Detroit, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
